narrative.intro: Barnard Construction has $5.9B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date across 11 awards, with an average award size of $535M and a year-over-year change of up 2967.7%. Barnard Construction received $4.5B from the Department of Homeland Security and $1.3B from the Department of Defense in FY2026 to date. Barnard Construction’s largest markets in FY2026 to date are Commercial and Institutional Building Construction at $4.5B and Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction at $1.3B. Historical obligations show small activity before FY2026: Barnard Construction obligated $5.2M in FY21, $132M in FY22, $4.1M in FY23, $33.4M in FY24, and $192M in FY25. Barnard Construction has minimal obligations in other program areas in FY2026 to date: Barnard Construction obligated $500K in Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction and $0 in Power and Communication Line and Related Structures Construction. The data are partial for the current fiscal year and contract-value totals are used for largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables where noted.

sections.heading: How concentrated are Barnard Construction's FY2026 federal obligations?
sections.body: Barnard Construction’s FY2026 obligations are highly concentrated in two accounts. The Department of Homeland Security provided $4.5B and the Department of Defense provided $1.3B. Barnard Construction’s top NAICS market is Commercial and Institutional Building Construction at $4.5B, followed by Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction at $1.3B. Barnard Construction has $500K in Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction and $0 in Power and Communication Line and Related Structures Construction.

sections.heading: How does Barnard Construction's FY2026 activity compare with prior years?
sections.body: Barnard Construction’s FY2026 obligations of $5.9B far exceed prior fiscal years. Barnard Construction obligated $5.2M in FY21, $132M in FY22, $4.1M in FY23, $33.4M in FY24, and $192M in FY25. Barnard Construction’s award count in FY2026 to date is 11, with an average award size of $535M. Barnard Construction’s year-over-year change is up 2967.7%.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Barnard Construction?
